files: historian_<GROUP>_<YYYYMM>.csv; GROUP is SUB01..SUB05 (substation and its RTU), DSS01, GEN01, WTP, BOOSTERS, TANKS, DIST, SYSTEM; one file per group and calendar month (UTC)
format: CSV, sorted by tag then time
standard: Process historian archive export, four columns (tag, time, value, quality)

fields.name: Tagname
fields.notes: tagname in scada_tags.json; equipment_id and site_id there join to infrastructure_assets.json and gw_host_registry.json

fields.name: Value
fields.type: number, integer state or hex string
fields.notes: engineering units and value_map are in scada_tags.json; empty when Quality is 0

fields.name: Quality
fields.notes: 192 good; 0 no data (first row of a telemetry gap); 64 uncertain (first scan after a gap); 216 manually entered

archive_behaviour.analog points: a row when the value moves by more than the point's compression deadband, and at least hourly (every 15 minutes for zone pressures, header pressure and bus voltages). Scans sit on a 5-minute grid with a fixed per-site offset of a few seconds.
archive_behaviour.status points: a row at the exact second of every change, plus an hourly heartbeat
archive_behaviour.setpoints: a row at the exact second of every write, plus a heartbeat
archive_behaviour.command points (*.CMD.SP): a row only when a command is written (0 open, 1 close); the first row of the file is the last command before the export window
archive_behaviour.configuration CRC points: hex string; a row on change plus a heartbeat every 6 hours
archive_behaviour.telemetry gaps: when a site stops reporting, each of its tags gets one row with empty Value and Quality 0 and then nothing until it reports again; RTU health tags (GW.RTUn.COMMS.STS, SCAN_AGE) are computed by the master station and continue

time_rule: All timestamps are UTC to the second. Records in different systems that describe the same action (a write in the device log, the value change in the historian, the session in the remote-access log) agree to within a few seconds; a status change that follows a command is stamped 1-3 s after the command.

join_keys.outage_map: feeder_id = equipment_id of the feeder breaker tags (GW.SUBn.CBx.*)
join_keys.fuel_deliveries: GW.UTL1.GEN.FUEL.PV is the level of tank EQP-1140

notes: No column or value labels any record. Row counts: about 1.17 million rows, 60 MB.
